🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive (Mixed/Rotation). VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) and SPY/TLT falling (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -10.10%), BELOW TREND, confirm rising fear and bonds outperforming stocks.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear increasing: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%). Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD falling (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%), BELOW TREND; stocks lagging bonds: SPY/TLT falling (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -10.10%), BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength indicator rising (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.38%), ABOVE TREND; yield curve indicator rising (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +4.50%), ABOVE TREND. Dollar firmness and curve steepening are mixed signals for conditions.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensives and select cyclicals held up: XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +7.98%), XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%), and XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +5.25%). Tech is weak: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%); Tech/Financials ratio falling (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -20.65%), BELOW TREND; Style: Value over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are BELOW TREND: SPY (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%); Europe’s VGK is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +2.20%), while China’s FXI is ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +4.48%). Emerging markets lag: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -10.24%); India’s INDA is ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.64% | 1M: +11.70%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative appetite is weak: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -13.86%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -7.31%). Small caps also lag, with IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Defensive demand supports gold: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -1.61%); Gold/Stocks ratio rising (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +2.57%), ABOVE TREND. Copper is weak: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.54%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is under pressure: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -12.00% | 1M: -5.55%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -12.84% | 1M: -2.23%). Natural gas is in RECOVERY: UNG (1W: +2.97% | 1M: -13.51%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Risk-off confirmation: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%), TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%), and VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%). Leadership is split: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) versus XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%).

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor relative resilience in XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) and XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +7.98%); reduce exposure to XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%). TLT is ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%), while credit remains a watchpoint.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth stabilizes and financial strength persists, monitor XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%).
BEARISH: If tech weakness broadens, monitor XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) for further downside.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If defensive demand continues, monitor GLD RECOVERY (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -1.61%).
BEARISH: If cycle indicators weaken further, monitor CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.54%).

13. Key Levels?
Monitor VXX at 21.95 (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%), ABOVE TREND; HYG/LQD at 0.7388, falling (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%), BELOW TREND. Also watch SPY/TLT at 8.9757, falling (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -10.10%), BELOW TREND, and Tech/Financials at 2.8821, falling (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -20.65%), BELOW TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive (Mixed/Rotation), confirmed by rising fear and bonds outperforming stocks. Financials and consumer staples show relative strength, with Value over Growth leadership. Monitor whether tech weakness deepens and credit stress continues to rise.
